Let’s Seduce the Heroine is about a girl who is reincarnated into the villainess of an otome game. In order to avoid her scripted demise, she realizes she has to seduce the heroine! It’s a yuri only story where you must survive as the “evil queen” in an otome game.  

The game will be released later this year and I'm very excited about it!

notes.title: Announcing Wolf Tails!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lnT2rqJ.jpg[/img]
Thanks for clicking on the store page for “Wolf Tails”. This is my fifth game and I’m very excited to share it with you all. Between the cute story, adorable wolf-girl heroines, and the visual style - I think this title will be very enjoyable for players. 
 
Also, on top of Naso4’s gorgeous CG illustrations, we will have animated “intros” to the CG scenes, which is a short segment featuring animation before the CG appears. Along with the high quality backgrounds for the setting, I think it really pushes the visual presentation to be something special.

The game features a chooseable gender protagonist and I’ve taken the feedback from "Happy Campers" into consideration. In Wolf Tails there’s more dialog differences plus gender specific cut-ins during certain scenes.  

I’m aiming for a Late April/Early May release depending on factors with Steam’s approval process.

Thank you for your continued support! 

Website: http://razzartvisual.com/ (for news about Wolf Tails)
